title: feat: add admin-controlled dashboard status notice
author: kreggscode
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #12585

- Adds a KV-backed public status notice endpoint.
- Adds admin-protected publish and clear endpoints under `/api/admin/status-notice`.
- Shows a dismissible warning across the dashboard and restores it after refresh.
- Validates message length and optional HTTP(S) links.

Checks: Biome, Enter typecheck, production frontend build.

gist.headline: A note on the dashboard door
gist.blurb: The dashboard can now leave a polite note when the hive needs everyone’s attention. Admins publish it once; dismissed notices still know how to find their way back after a refresh.
gist.summary: Added a KV-backed public status-notice endpoint plus admin publish and clear controls under `/api/admin/status-notice`, with a dismissible dashboard warning that persists across refreshes and validates message length and optional HTTP(S) links.
gist.impact: Dashboard users can reliably see and revisit administrator status updates, while admins get a validated, centralized way to post or clear notices without redeploying the frontend.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the dashboard as a cozy garden-shed control room with a large retro terminal displaying a friendly status notice banner. Polli, wearing a tiny caretaker hat and holding a clipboard, gently pins the notice to the monitor while small code-plants and flowers grow around the terminal; the scene represents a persistent, admin-posted message reaching the whole dashboard.
